name: plugin-manylives
description: ElizaOS plugin: verifiable trading-strategy track records, market brief, position sizing and token verdicts for trading agents, pay per call from a capped wallet (free trial without one).

MANYLIVES_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional: key of a small dedicated Base wallet holding a little USDC. Without it, the free trial gives 3 calls a day.

MANYLIVES_MAX_USD_PER_DAY.description: Stop paying after this much per day (default 1)
